description: The PowerPoint editor of office-com-host.ps1 (Apply-PowerPointOperation, 46 operations) run through the PowerShell host's own sessions: every operation with the argument sets of the live PowerPoint tests and every refusal; two and three charts in one background batch so the open-data-sheet and Excel-reuse paths run; a chart refresh that adds a period under a last-point accent; templates with particles and repeated tokens; import_slides and keep_slides; a background batch failing after a replace_text so the deck checkpoint reload runs; a visible-session batch with Undo. Recorded on the migration PC with Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel (record-office-com.mjs --area ppt-edit) and replayed by tests/ppt_edit.rs against the fake dispatch object: the call log is cut at the operation markers, and the answers of the process and window layer are scripted on the fake platform from the recorded window handles. Not covered by the recorder's step kinds: apply_theme with a theme file (it needs a .thmx this repository does not carry: only its refusal is recorded), and an installation of PowerPoint in another UI language (layout names follow it): the Korean-UI deck is these scenarios recorded on a Korean-UI PC.

scenarios.description: Text boxes, shapes, text edits and shape arrangement: add_textbox with paragraphs, bullets, faces, fill, outline, margins, spacing and shadow; add_shape in every portable geometry and the line; set_shape with null colours and percentages; replace_text across spaces, soft breaks, the notes and one slide; set_text; fit_text; delete_shape, z_order, align_shapes, distribute_shapes, group_shapes, ungroup_shape, set_hyperlink, add_provenance, set_notes. The refusals each get a batch of their own.

operations.text: A long line of text that has to shrink to fit the narrow box it was given by the slide author

expect.contains: Unsupported shapeType: blob. Use one of:
z_order command must be front, back, forward, or backward
group_shapes requires at least two shape indexes
add_provenance requires source with a document or label

scenarios.description: Tables and pictures: add_table with figure columns (signs, currency, Korean units), column widths and row heights, header and body fills; set_table_data growing and shrinking the table with the last row's type copied; set_table_cell_style; add_image stretched, contained and covered around a focus; replace_image keeping the frame; crop_image; add_media with an embedded sound.

expect.contains: Image fit must be stretch, contain, or cover

scenarios.description: The slide operations: add_slide in the preceding slide's layout and by name (the English default names in any UI language), type, number and refusal; set_layout; duplicate, move, delete and keep; visibility, transition, animation, background; comments; footer and slide number on a layout with a footer placeholder and on one without; fill_template with particles and repeated tokens; import_slides after the source deck is closed and its refusal while it is open.

expect.contains: PowerPoint layout 'No Such Layout' not found; available layouts:
PowerPoint layout index out of range: 99
set_slide_visibility requires visible: true or false
PowerPoint comment index out of range: 9
import_slides requires the saved source deck to be closed before import

scenarios.description: Charts with the embedded data sheet: add_chart of every kind with series, point colours, labels, legend, axis and title fields; two and three charts in one background batch (the open data sheet and the Excel reuse); a refresh that adds a period under a last-point accent and a bar chart's category order; set_chart_series, set_chart_axis, set_chart_trendline, set_chart_error_bars and set_chart_data_labels; every chart refusal.

expect.contains: set_chart_error_bars direction must be x or y
orders a horizontal bar chart's categories
PowerPoint chart data requires at least one series

scenarios.description: A background batch that fails after a replace_text: the deck is reloaded from the checkpoint, so the text is what it was and the later snapshot shows it.

expect.contains: z_order command must be front, back, forward, or backward

scenarios.description: A visible-session batch: each operation starts an undo entry; a failing batch is taken back through Undo until the deck reads as it did; a later batch of the same session succeeds.
